from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashReport(BaseModel):
    """A single company's cash position extracted from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific label used in the document for the cash amount (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of cash reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_reports: list[CashReport]
